H2800.def: the same as «02799»; Charosheth, a place in Palestine:--Harosheth.

H2802.def: from «02801» (but equivalent to «02793»); forest; Chereth, a thicket in Palestine:--Hereth.

H2803.def: a primitive root; properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (gen.) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute:--(make) account (of), conceive, consider, count, cunning (man, work, workman), devise, esteem, find out, forecast, hold, imagine, impute, invent, be like, mean, purpose, reckon(-ing be made), regard, think.

H2805.def: from «02803»; a belt or strap (as being interlaced):--curious girdle.

H2806.def: from «02803» and «01777»; considerate judge; Chasbaddanah, an Israelite:--Hasbadana.

H2808.def: from «02803»; properly, contrivance; by implication, intelligence:--account, device, reason.

H2809.def: the same as «02808»; Cheshbon, a place East of the Jordan:--Heshbon.

H2810.def: from «02803»; a contrivance, i.e. actual (a warlike machine) or mental (a machination):--engine, invention.

H2811.def: or Chashabyahuw {khash-ab-yaw'-hoo}; from «02803» and «03050»; Jah has regarded; Chashabjah, the name of nine Israelites:--Hashabiah.

H2812.def: feminine of «02808»; inventiveness; Chashnah, an Israelite:--Hashabnah.

H2813.def: from «02808» and «03050»; thought of Jah; Chashabnejah, the name of two Israelites:--Hashabniah.

H2814.def: a primitive root; to hush or keep quiet:--hold peace, keep silence, be silent, (be) still.

H2815.def: from «02803»; intelligent; Chashshub, the name of two or three Israelites:--Hashub, Hasshub.

H2816.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «02821»; the dark:--darkness.

H2817.def: or Chasuphao {khas-oo-faw'}; from «02834»; nakedness; Chasupha, one of the Nethinim:--Hashupha, Hasupha.

H2818.et: a collateral root to one corresponding to (02363) in the sense of readiness
H2818.def: (Aramaic) a collateral root to one corresponding to «02363» in the sense of readiness; to be necessary (from the idea of convenience) or (transitively) to need:--careful, have need of.

H2819.def: from a root corresponding to «02818»; necessity:--be needful.

H2820.def: a primitive root; to restrain or (reflex.) refrain; by implication, to refuse, spare, preserve; also (by interch. with «02821») to observe:--assuage, × darken, forbear, hinder, hold back, keep (back), punish, refrain, reserve, spare, withhold.

H2821.def: a primitive root; to be dark (as withholding light); transitively, to darken:--be black, be (make) dark, darken, cause darkness, be dim, hide.

H2822.def: from «02821»; the dark; hence (literally) darkness; figuratively, misery, destruction, death, ignorance, sorrow, wickedness:--dark(-ness), night, obscurity.

H2825.def: or chashekah {khash-ay-kaw'}; from «02821»; darkness; figuratively, misery:--darkness.

H2826.def: a primitive root; to make (intrans. be) unsteady, i.e. weak:--feeble.

H2827.def: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to «02826»; to weaken, i.e. crush:--subdue.

H2828.def: from the same as «02831»; enriched; Chashum, the name of two or three Israelites:--Hashum.

H2829.def: the same as «02831»; opulent; Cheshmon, a place in Palestine:--Heshmon.

H2830.def: of uncertain derivation; probably bronze or polished spectrum metal:--amber.

H2831.et: from an unused root (probably meaning firm or capacious in resources)
H2831.def: from an unused root (probably meaning firm or capacious in resources); apparently wealthy:--princes.

H2832.def: feminine of «02831»; fertile; Chasmonah, a place in the Desert:--Hashmonah.

H2833.et: from an unused root probably meaning to contain or sparkle
H2833.def: from an unused root probably meaning to contain or sparkle; perhaps a pocket (as holding the Urim and Thummim), or rich (as containing gems), used only of the gorget of the highpriest:--breastplate.

H2834.def: a primitive root; to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked (for exertion or in disgrace), to drain away or bail up (a liquid):--make bare, clean, discover, draw out, take, uncover.

H2835.def: from «02834»; properly, drawn off, i.e. separated; hence, a small company (as divided from the rest):--little flock.

H2836.def: a primitive root; to cling, i.e. join, (figuratively) to love, delight in; elliptically (or by interchangeable for «02820») to deliver:--have a delight, (have a ) desire, fillet, long, set (in) love.

H2838.def: or chashuwq {khaw-shook'}; past participle of «02836»; attached, i.e. a fence-rail or rod connecting the posts or pillars:--fillet.

H2839.def: from «02836»; conjoined, i.e. a wheel-spoke or rod connecting the hub with the rim:--felloe.

H2840.et: from an unused root meaning to bind together
H2840.def: from an unused root meaning to bind together; combined, i.e. the nave or hub of a wheel (as holding the spokes together):--spoke.

H2841.def: from the same as «02840»; properly, a combination or gathering, i.e. of watery clouds:--dark.

H2843.def: patronymically from «02364»; a Chushathite or descendant of Chushah:--Hushathite.

H2844.def: from «02865»; concretely, crushed; also afraid; abstractly, terror:--broken, dismayed, dread, fear.

H2845.def: from «02865»; terror; Cheth, an aboriginal Canaanite:--Heth.

H2846.def: a primitive root; to lay hold of; especially to pick up fire:--heap, take (away).

H2850.def: patronymically from «02845»; a Chittite, or descendant of Cheth:--Hittite, Hittities.

H2852.def: a primitive root; properly, to cut off, i.e. (figuratively) to decree:--determine.

H2853.def: a primitive root; to swathe:--X at all, swaddle.

H2855.def: from «02853»; enswathed; Chethlon, a place in Palestine:--Hethlon.

H2856.def: a primitive root; to close up; especially to seal:--make an end, mark, seal (up), stop.

H2857.def: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to «02856»; to seal:--seal.

H2858.def: feminine active participle of «02856»; a seal:--signet.

H2859.def: a primitive root; to give (a daughter) away in marriage; hence (generally) to contract affinity by marriage:--join in affinity, father in law, make marriages, mother in law, son in law.

H2860.def: from «02859»; a relative by marriage (especially through the bride); figuratively, a circumcised child (as a species of religious espousal):--bridegroom, husband, son in law.

H2862.def: a primitive root; to clutch:--take away.

H2864.def: a primitive root; to force a passage, as by burglary; figuratively, with oars:--dig (through), row.

H2865.def: a primitive root; properly, to prostrate; hence, to break down, either (literally) by violence, or (figuratively) by confusion and fear:--abolish, affright, be (make) afraid, amaze, beat down, discourage, (cause to) dismay, go down, scare, terrify.

H2867.def: the same as «02866»; Chathath, an Israelite:--cathath.

H2868.def: (Aramaic) a primitive root; to rejoice:--be glad.

H2869.def: (Aramaic) from «02868»; the same as «02896»; good:--fine, good.

H2870.def: from «02895» and «0410»; pleasing (to) God; Tabeel, the name of a Syrian and of a Persian:--Tabeal, Tabeel.

H2871.def: passive participle of «02881»; properly, dyed, i.e. a turban (probably as of colored stuff):--dyed attire.

H2872.et: from an unused root meaning to pile up; properly, accumulated
H2872.def: from an unused root meaning to pile up; properly, accumulated; i.e. (by implication) a summit:--middle, midst.

H2873.def: a primitive root; to slaughter (animals or men):--kill, (make) slaughter, slay.

H2874.def: from «02873»; properly, something slaughtered; hence, a beast (or meat, as butchered); abstr. butchery (or concretely, a place of slaughter):--X beast, slaughter, × slay, × sore.

H2875.def: the same as «02874»; massacre; Tebach, the name of a Mesopotamian and of an Israelite:--Tebah.

H2876.def: from «02873»; properly, a butcher; hence, a lifeguardsman (because he was acting as an executioner); also a cook (usually slaughtering the animal for food):--cook, guard.

H2878.def: feminine of «02874» and meaning the same:--flesh, slaughter.

H2880.def: from «02878»; slaughter; Tibchath, a place in Syria:--Tibhath.

H2881.def: a primitive root; to dip, to immerse:--dip, plunge.

H2882.def: from «02881» and «03050»; Jah has dipped; Tebaljah, an Israelite:--Tebaliah.

H2883.def: a primitive root; to sink:--drown, fasten, settle, sink.

H2884.def: plural of «02885»; rings; Tabbaoth, one of the Nethinim:--Tabaoth.

H2885.def: from «02883»; properly, a seal (as sunk into the wax), i.e. signet (for sealing); hence (generally) a ring of any kind:--ring.

H2886.def: from «02895» and «07417»; pleasing (to) Rimmon; Tabrimmon, a Syrian:--Tabrimmon.

H2887.def: probably of foreign derivation; Tebeth, the tenth Heb. month:--Tebeth.

H2888.def: of uncertain derivation; Tabbath, a place East of the Jordan:--Tabbath.

H2889.def: or tahor {taw-hore'}; from «02891»; pure (in a physical, chemical, ceremonial or moral sense):--clean, fair, pure(-ness).

H2891.def: a primitive root; properly, to be bright; i.e. (by implication) to be pure (physical sound, clear, unadulterated; Levitically, uncontaminated; morally, innocent or holy):--be (make, make self, pronounce) clean, cleanse (self), purge, purify(-ier, self).

H2892.def: from «02891»; literally brightness; ceremonially purification:--clearness, glory, purifying.

H2893.def: feminine of «02892»; ceremonial purification; moral purity:--X is cleansed, cleansing, purification(-fying).

H2894.def: a primitive root; to sweep away:--sweep.

H2895.def: a primitive root, to be (transitively, do or make) good (or well) in the widest sense:--be (do) better, cheer, be (do, seem) good, (make) goodly, × please, (be, do, go, play) well.

H2896.def: from «02895»; good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well):--beautiful, best, better, bountiful, cheerful, at ease, × fair (word), (be in) favour, fine, glad, good (deed, -lier, -liest, -ly, -ness, -s), graciously, joyful, kindly, kindness, liketh (best), loving, merry, × most, pleasant, + pleaseth, pleasure, precious, prosperity, ready, sweet, wealth, welfare, (be) well ((-favoured)).

H2897.def: the same as «02896»; good; Tob, a region apparently East of the Jordan:--Tob.

H2898.def: from «02895»; good (as a noun), in the widest sense, especially goodness (superlative concretely, the best), beauty, gladness, welfare:--fair, gladness, good(-ness, thing, -s), joy, go well with.

H2899.def: from «02896» and «0138»; pleasing (to) Adonijah; Tob-Adonijah, an Israelite:--Tob-adonijah.
